xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature split"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature image"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Signature tag"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature panel"><e-div-block configuration-id="Signature ring"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature eyebrow"><e-div-block configuration-id="Signature eyebrow rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Signature eyebrow text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-heading configuration-id="Signature title"></e-heading><e-paragraph configuration-id="Signature body"></e-paragraph><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature list"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature item 1"><e-div-block configuration-id="Signature item 1 dash"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Signature item 1 text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature item 2"><e-div-block configuration-id="Signature item 2 dash"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Signature item 2 text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature item 3"><e-div-block configuration-id="Signature item 3 dash"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Signature item 3 text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox></e-flexbox><e-button configuration-id="Signature button"></e-button></e-flexbox></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

Signature title.title: Designed to impress, built to perform.

Signature body.paragraph: Modern elegance with flawless function. Our buffet and service solutions combine beauty and durability for hotels, banquets and luxury dining.

style.Signature split: padding: 0px; gap: 0px; align-items: stretch; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; }
style.Signature image: width: 700px; min-width: 700px; min-height: 640px; padding: 28px; align-items: flex-start; background-image: url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/home-signature-buffet.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; min-height: 520px; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; min-height: 300px; padding: 16px; }
style.Signature tag: padding: 12px 18px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%); font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-navy-deep); @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.4px; padding: 10px 14px; }
style.Signature panel: flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; flex-grow: 1; gap: 28px; padding: 64px; background-color: var(--on-navy); overflow: hidden; @media(--tablet){ padding: 56px 48px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 40px 24px; gap: 24px; }
style.Signature ring: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); background: transparent; left: 300px; top: -140px; width: 420px; height: 420px; min-width: 420px; border-color: rgba(226,187,108,0.35); @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -120px; } @media(--mobile){ left: auto; right: -200px; }
style.Signature title: font-size: 52px; line-height: 54px; color: #FFFFFF; max-width: 410px; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 44px; line-height: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 36px; line-height: 40px; }
style.Signature item 1 dash: width: 18px; min-width: 18px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Signature item 2 dash: width: 18px; min-width: 18px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Signature item 3 dash: width: 18px; min-width: 18px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
